abstract: FinThrive's 2026 RCM Investment Priorities Report (January 13, 2026) finds 76% of RCM leaders name automation as their #1 initiative and 56% identify automation and AI as their most significant investment area. Top AI deployment areas: prior authorization (73%), denials/underpayment management (67%), clinical documentation/coding (60%). Over 70% plan to reduce third-party RCM vendors; nearly 60% will consolidate RCM vendors within 3 years.
keyFindings: 76% of RCM leaders name automation as #1 initiative for 2026
56% identify automation and AI as most significant investment area
Top AI deployment: prior authorization (73%), denials (67%), documentation/coding (60%)
70%+ plan to reduce third-party RCM vendors; 60% will consolidate within 3 years
85% report changing RCM strategy in response to cybersecurity/clearinghouse disruptions
methodology: FinThrive-fielded survey of RCM leaders at US health systems.
qualifiers: FinThrive is an RCM technology vendor — the survey supports its own consolidation/AI narrative. 'Investment priority' is intent, not deployment. Directionally credible but self-serving in framing.
